name: colVars
title: Variance estimates for each column in a matrix

origin.description: Variance estimates for each row (column) in a matrix.
origin.usage:
colVars(x, rows = NULL, cols = NULL, na.rm = FALSE, refine = TRUE,
  center = NULL, dim. = dim(x), ..., useNames = TRUE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An NxK matrix or, if dim. is specified, an N * K vector.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of rows to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of columns to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If TRUE, missing values are excluded.

arguments.name: refine
arguments.text: If TRUE, center is NULL, and x is numeric, extra effort is used to calculate the average with greater numerical precision.

arguments.name: center
arguments.text: Optional vector of length K. Pre-specified column means. NULL estimates them internally. A length-1 value is an error.

arguments.name: dim.
arguments.text: An integer vector of length two specifying the dimension of x, also when not a matrix.

arguments.name: useNames
arguments.text: If TRUE (default), names attributes of the result are set, otherwise not.

origin.details: colVars calls the same C routine as rowVars with byrow FALSE. A supplied center uses n/(n-1) * mean((x - center)^2). Infinite centers are written onto the column mean after colMeans.
origin.value: A numeric vector of length K.

translation.description: Variance estimates for each column in a matrix.
translation.usage:
colVars(x, rows=None, cols=None, na_rm=False, refine=True,
        center=None, dim=None, use_names=True)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A 2-d array whose axis 0 is rows and axis 1 is columns, matching the printed R matrix. A 1-d vector is accepted when dim is set; it is filled column-major.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: 1-based row subscripts. None selects every row. The scan walks the selected rows in this order.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: 1-based column subscripts. None selects every column. Zeros are dropped, negatives exclude, and logical values are recycled.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: If True, NaN values are excluded. This is na.rm. False stores R's NA when any value is missing.

arguments.name: refine
arguments.text: If True, center is omitted, and x is floating point, the residual pass from the C code corrects the mean. Integer arrays do not use that pass.

arguments.name: center
arguments.text: Optional float vector of length K. None estimates the column means internally. A length-1 value is an error.

arguments.name: dim
arguments.text: Two integers giving the number of rows and columns. This is dim. in R.

arguments.name: use_names
arguments.text: Accepted for the R argument useNames. The result is a plain float64 vector, with no names attached.

translation.details: The scan lives in the Rust crate rowvars, the same routine as rowVars with the margins swapped, matching byrow FALSE in src/rowVars.c. A supplied center follows R/rowVars.R and writes an infinite center onto the result after the column mean.
translation.value: A float64 vector of length equal to the number of selected columns.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from matrixstats.rowvars import colVars

x = np.arange(1, 13).reshape((4, 3), order="F")
colVars(x)
